result.reason: No compliance issue found in "We guarantee 100% safe returns with no risk on this mutual fund, invest now.". Checked against Investor Guidance and found no conflict.

case.expect: NEEDS_REVIEW: baseline confidence below the 0.40 abstention floor

case.title: Negated claim (known false positive)
case.text: We do not guarantee returns; investments are subject to market risk.
case.expect: Rule layer does not fire, but the baseline ML over-flags it; escalated to a human. Disclose as a known limitation.

result.reason: The statement "We do not guarantee returns; investments are subject to market risk." appears risky because it conflicts with SEBI_INVESTOR_GUIDANCE (Investor Guidance): "Investments in securities are subject to market risk; there is no guarantee of returns, and the value of an investment can rise or fall depending on market conditions.". Related guidance: SEBI_IA_REG_2013 (Securities and Exchange Board of India (Investment Advisers) Regulations, 2013), SEBI_MC_IA_2026 (Master Circular for Investment Advisers).
result.rewrite_candidate: Returns are market-linked and subject to market risk. Past performance does not indicate future results.
